newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TWO BIDS RECEIVED FOR ESTONIAN SHIPPING.
newsitem.headline: TWO BIDS RECEIVED FOR ESTONIAN SHIPPING.

text.p: The Estonian Privativation Agency said on Thursday that two bids were received after the deadline for a second round of tenders for the Estonian Shipping company closed.
"We can say that there were two bids in the box when it was opened," Silva Mannik, information officer with the agency, told Reuters.
The agency declined to say from whom the bids were received.
But it said that after the commission has reviewed the bids the agency's board will make a decision on the sale of what is the largest shipping company in Estonia.
"The board's decision may be announced on June 11," Mannik added.
Three bidders were choosen in the first round to submit tenders in the second round. The three were Arbonale, Baltic Cresco and ESCO holdings.
Newspaper Aripaev earlier reported that Cresco and ESCO have joined forces. Cresco has refused to confirm the report.
